text_block_list.text:
One day, a petty argument between El
Condor
Pasa and Сикинг зе Пёрл
escalates into a
wrestling showdown!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We may be doing this for fun, but as
long as it's
wrestling...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Then I'm gonna go all out!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Heh! I certainly hope so! Now come...
let's see
how your skills hold up on the
world stage!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Of course they do! One day, my name
will be
known the world over!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El, this seems dangerous. You should
quit before
it's too late...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No way! I'll never turn down a challenge!
I've got
the blood of a fighter in me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Pearl!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yaaah!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ A big tackle like that isn't
going to work
on me!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Сикинг зе Пёрл takes a big step back
and
avoids Эль Кондор Паса's attack! The
audience's
eyes are glued on the action.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It's not over yet!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... You can't touch this!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Сикинг зе Пёрл dodges another tackle
from El
Condor Pasa, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Ha! She's dodging with big steps to the
outside.
If I make a sharp dive from the
inside...)
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Эль Кондор Паса runs into a leap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Take this! El Especiaaalll!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса steps swiftly behind
Seeking the
Pearl and puts her in an
armlock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uncle! Uncle! I give up!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Victoria! My first victory with
the El
Especial!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What in the world are you all doing?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El, I want to see you in the student
council office
later. Pearl, you can join
us.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса gets a rather stern
lecture, but her
movements have also
developed a decisive edge
from her
match.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
